documents.title: Customer incident description (written statement)
documents.text:
Statement - claim for KA03HF2210 (Devraj Kulkarni)

On Saturday 21st Feb night I was returning home from a friend's wedding reception at a resort near Whitefield. I left the venue around 11.15-11.30 pm. I had two-three drinks at the reception over the evening but I was feeling fine to ride.

On the ORR service road near Marathahalli there is a sharpish left where the road narrows. It was quite dark and there was loose mud near the edge. The bike slipped when I leaned into the turn and went into the metal barrier on the side. I got some scrapes on my hand and knee but thankfully nothing serious, I was wearing my helmet and jacket.

The bike's tank got dented on the right side, the front fork is bent and the headlamp broke. It is at Highway Motors, Marathahalli. Their estimate is Rs 38,700 which is attached.

I accept it was late at night and visibility was poor. Requesting you to kindly process the claim.

Devraj Kulkarni
24/02/2026
